subject: Hosted API — Data ephemerality & deletion controls (security questionnaire)

Subject: NovumTech sec questionnaire — hosted API data residency & deletion

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this. Attached is our standard security questionnaire — we specifically need clarifications on data residency, retention windows, deletion mechanisms, and how backups/derivative artifacts are handled for Redwood's hosted API. A few targeted questions:

1) Where (region/zone) is request/response content stored by default? Can we constrain storage to EU only for our account?
2) What are the default retention windows for: raw request payloads, generated outputs, model-derived artifacts (embeddings, caches), and auth/audit logs?
3) Do you offer an API/portal for customer-initiated data deletion and what is the SLA?
4) How long do backups (snapshots) persist after deletion requests? Are backups encrypted/isolated by account?
5) Are derivations (embeddings, reranking indices) treated as customer data and removed on delete?
6) What legal/operational exceptions (e.g., legal holds) might delay deletion?

We'd appreciate concise answers we can include in our vendor-risk portal. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min call — next available window for us is Mon/Tue morning PST.

Thanks,
Laura Jennings
Sr. Information Security Manager | NovumTech

Subject: Re: NovumTech sec questionnaire — hosted API data residency & deletion

Laura — thanks for the questionnaire. Below are concise, actionable answers to your targeted items. I've kept the responses scoped to the hosted API; if you need Private/Dedicated specifics we can provide those in a follow-up. Looping in Dev (solutions) for API-level details and Rishi (privacy/legal) for legal hold & DPA comments.

1) Data residency (default):
- Default deployment region for new hosted accounts is us-west-2.
- We offer EU region pinning (eu-central-1) for customers who require EU-only storage; this is enabled at account provisioning time for hosted customers — please indicate in onboarding or we can initiate a region change with minimal downtime.

2) Retention windows (hosted API defaults):
- Request & response payloads (full content): retained for 30 days for debugging, abuse detection, and quality monitoring.
- Safety/telemetry artifacts (anonymized): retained for 90 days; personally-identifiable details are redacted or hashed when possible for telemetry.
- Model-derived caches (KV cache, temporary embeddings): ephemeral by design; default retention 14 days unless customer opts into longer caching for billing/performance.
- Audit & auth logs (access events, token usage): retained 365 days by default; can be extended for enterprise contracts.

3) Customer-initiated deletion:
- We expose a Delete Customer Data API (POST /v1/accounts/{acct}/data/delete) which initiates deletion of primary copies within 72 hours. We will provide a signed confirmation once primary data is removed.
- Deletion scope includes request/response payloads, associated generated outputs, and account-level caches.

4) Backups & snapshots:
- Backups are encrypted and account-segregated logical snapshots. After a deletion request, primary copies are deleted within the SLA above; backup snapshots are scheduled for normal rotation and purged within 120 days by default.
- For enterprise customers we can negotiate accelerated backup purge timelines or provide private deployment options with shorter backup windows.

5) Derivative artifacts:
- Embeddings, reranking indices, and any derivatives created and persisted in association with your account are treated as customer data and included in the deletion flow. Short-lived internal caches that are not persisted for more than the cache window are ephemeral and cleared per the retention policy above.

6) Exceptions & legal holds: 
- Deletion may be delayed if subject to a lawful preservation request, subpoena, or regulatory requirement. We notify customers if a legal hold applies and provide the minimum disclosure necessary.

Attachments & artifacts: we can provide an export of account data (structured JSON) on request; secure transfer via our support portal or SFTP can be arranged.

Next steps: I can (a) send a one-page summary suitable for vendor-risk intake, (b) provide API spec + sample curl for the Delete endpoint, and (c) open a support ticket to export your current account data. Which would you like first?

Best,
Olga Petrov

Hi Olga — thanks, that's very helpful. A few clarifying points before we escalate to procurement/legal:

• The 30-day window for request/response content — is that configurable per-account, or fixed for hosted?
• For backup purges (120 days) we need an option ≤30 days for sensitive PII workloads; can that be contracted for hosted customers?
• Can you confirm that the Delete API also removes any embeddings persisted to the model-service layer and any persisted indexes? We need explicit confirmation we won't be able to reconstruct inputs from persisted derivatives.

Also: we'll need a copy of your DPA and SOC2 report to attach to our vendor record. Prefer to get the one-page vendor summary first so our security reviewer can sign off on direction.

Thanks — available for a quick call Tue morning PST if that helps.

—Laura

Laura — quick follow-up from the engineering side; apologies for the long message, trying to be explicit.

- Configurability: Retention windows for hosted accounts are configurable at account provisioning time. For request/response content we can set a shorter retention (example: 7, 14, 30 days) as part of your onboarding. Post-provision changes require an operational ticket and may have a short scheduling window.

- Backup purge SLA: We do offer contracted backup purge timelines for hosted enterprise agreements. While the default backup purge is 120 days, we can include a ≤30 day backup purge clause in an enterprise addendum for accounts with PII requirements; this typically requires a higher support tier or dedicated tenancy.

- Delete API scope & irrecoverability: The Delete Customer Data API removes primary stored copies and marks associated derivatives for immediate deletion. Persisted embeddings and indices that are linked to your account are included in the deletion workflow; our system overwrites and cryptographically deletes index pointers from active storage. Complete irrecoverability from all backups occurs on the backup purge cadence described above unless accelerated purge is contracted.

- DPA & SOC2: Rishi — can you share the current DPA and the redacted SOC2 attestation PDF for NovumTech's vendor intake?

- Action items I'm initiating now:
  • Opening support ticket: https://support.redwood-inference.example.com/ticket/54621 (we'll use this for data export & deletion confirmation)
  • Attaching our Delete API spec to the ticket (DataDeletion_API_Specs.pdf)
  • Drafting a 1-page vendor summary for Laura (will send within 24 hours)
